remainingLimits: No full Stagewise parity claim; this slice covers Stagewise question-wrapper rendering and source preference text.

Bridge configured means callback configuration was successfully produced; it is not proof that an arbitrary helper executable launched. Actual self-helper launch and form response are covered by the native subprocess fixtures.
Offscreen component renders are not actual packaged MainWindow/foreground/live OpenCode verification. No credentials or real user profiles were used.
